story: The Breakers was built between 1893 and 1895 for Cornelius Vanderbilt II. Richard Morris Hunt designed it, and the family used it as a summer home.
The Vanderbilts had an earlier mansion on the site, but it burned on November 25, 1892. So the new house was built to be fireproof, using masonry and steel.
Today the house is owned by the Preservation Society of Newport County. It was listed on the National Register of Historic Places in 1971 and became a National Historic Landmark in 1994.
stops.fact: The Breakers was built after the first mansion on the site burned in November 1892.
stops.disputed: Many people picture the mansion as a century-old cottage that was always here. Wikipedia says the first house on the site burned in 1892.

stops.teaser: A public path along the sea that the mansion owners kept trying to block.
stops.clue: Go to the Forty Steps, a stone stairway that leads down toward the water from the Cliff Walk, near Narragansett Avenue. Look for the path along the cliff edge with the ocean on one side.
stops.safety: Parts of the path are rough, narrow and uneven, and sections have collapsed in storms. Stay on the marked path, keep back from the edge, and do not climb on the rocks.

story: The Newport Cliff Walk is a 3.5-mile (5.6 km) public path along the shore. It is a National Recreation Trail, the first in New England, and it gives views of mansions such as The Breakers and Marble House.

The right to walk the shore goes back to 1663, when the charter from King Charles II promised Rhode Island colonists the right to fish along the shoreline. Around 1880, mansion owners began building a simple path in sections.

Over the years, wealthy owners sometimes put up fences, boulders or walls to block the path. Storms have also damaged it: in October 2012, Hurricane Sandy washed away large sections, and it did not reopen until June 2014.
stops.fact: The Cliff Walk was the first National Recreation Trail in New England.
stops.disputed: Many people think the mansion owners built the walk to welcome the public. Wikipedia says they sometimes put up fences, boulders and walls to block it.

claims.t: Hurricane Sandy did no damage to the Cliff Walk.

story: James Gordon Bennett Jr. had the Newport Casino built between 1879 and 1881 as a social club. The architects were McKim, Mead & White, and it opened in July 1880. It is a leading example of the Shingle style.
It was the site of the first U.S. lawn tennis championships, and the Tennis Hall of Fame has been here since 1954.
The Casino was designated a National Historic Landmark in 1987.
stops.fact: The Newport Casino hosted the first U.S. lawn tennis championships.
stops.disputed: Many people hear 'casino' and picture slot machines. Wikipedia says this was a social club that opened in 1880.

claims.t: The Newport Casino was built as a gambling hall.

story: The Old Stone Mill, also called the Newport Tower, stands in Touro Park. It is about 28 feet (8.5 m) tall and about 22 to 23 feet across.
For a long time people argued about who built it, and some guessed it was Viking. Wikipedia says carbon-14 testing indicates it is the remains of a 17th-century windmill.
A document from 1741 already calls it 'the old stone mill'. It is a good example of an old mystery with a well-tested answer.

stops.disputed: Many people repeat the Viking story. Wikipedia says carbon-14 testing indicates a 17th-century windmill.
